items.evidence: README play command with --ticks 5 --settings fresh folder printed one JSON object, screen title, with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
--frame title.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; `file` says 800 x 480 RGBA; image shows the title screen.
Fresh folder: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 1:enter -> tick 2 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.
Settings: 10 lefts took volume 8->0 and stayed 0; 12 rights 1->10 and stayed 10; language en->es->fr, stops at fr and at en; difficulty normal default, easy/normal/hard, no wrap past either end.

es: title Mejor/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir, settings Ajustes/Volumen/Idioma/Dificultad/Volver, play Oleada 1 de 8/Puntos/Monedas/Puerta, paused En pausa/Seguir/Titulo, shop Tienda..., won Has ganado, lost Has perdido. fr: Record/Commencer/Reglages/Quitter, Vague 1 sur 8, Pause/Reprendre/Titre, Boutique..., Gagne, Perdu, Entree : titre. Only the name stays English (Spanish end screens keep the key name 'Enter: titulo').
Run 1 set volume 1, language fr; run 2 on same folder started fr/vol 1 and set vol 10, hard; settings.json and a later run showed fr,10,hard. A fresh folder starts en, 8, normal.
down held ticks 10-40: guard_y 6->3 (6 units/s); held down further stops at 0; up 200->260: 0->6; up held long stops at 12.
shoot held from tick 10: new bolts at ticks 11, 35, 59 (24 ticks); bolt x advances 0.2333/tick (14/s); a bolt at 17.17 is gone 20 ticks later (past 20).
Wave 1 seed 1: walkers enter at ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (90 ticks) at x 20 in lanes 4,10,6,2,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5/s); 5 in all.
Scripted guard cleared wave 1: each walker hp 2->1 on first bolt, gone on second with score +10, coins +1 (50 and 5 after 5 kills); bolts at y=6 passed a walker at y=4 with its health unchanged.
Wave 2 passive: each walker at x<=0 removed, gate 10->9->...->3, score and coins stay 0; save with gate 2: at tick 960 screen lost, texts show Score 30 (fr 'Score : 30', es 'Puntos: 30').
Difficulty Easy then Start: gate_health 14, text 'Gate: 14'; Hard then Start: gate_health 7 ('Porte : 7').

After wave 1 cleared, screen shop from ~tick 530; enemies and bolts empty, state unchanged ticks 550-900; texts Shop, Coins: 5, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands: 5 coins..., Heavy bolts: 12 coins..., Mason: 4 coins..., Next wave.
Coins 40: Quick 40->35 (level 1), ->25 (level 2), third Enter coins stay 25. In play, quick 1 bolts at ticks 8, 26, 44 (18); quick 2 at 8, 20, 32, 44 (12).
Heavy bought 30->18 coins, heavy 1; further Enter leaves 18/1. With heavy, wave 2 walker (hp 2) destroyed by first bolt: score 50->60, coins +1.
Gate 5 coins 40 normal: Mason 5->8 (36), 8->10 (32, capped), next Enter no change; gate 10 coins 40: no change; gate 5 coins 3: no change.
Next wave at tick 6 -> play at 7, first walker enters tick 67 (60 ticks); wave 2 passive run saw 7 walkers enter 90 ticks apart; text 'Wave 2 of 8'.
Wave 3 (easy save): 6 walkers then 4 runners entering every 72 ticks; runner hp 1, x drops 3.6 per 72 ticks (3/s); heavy guard in lane 2 killed a runner: score +15, coins +1.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute (tick 643) hp 6, 1 unit/s; reaching the gate took gate 6->3; shot down in lane 8 it gave score 0->40, coins 0->3.
modules/work/waves.json holds walkers/runners/brutes/every per wave, read by wave_plan; README 'Change a wave' says to edit it.

Continue of a wave-7 save (gate 99 easy, quick 2, heavy) played wave 8: killed enemies worth 140, gate left 80, screen won with score 1740 (=140+20*80); Enter -> title. Not a full 8-wave run from Start; the end-of-run rule was seen through a crafted save.

Escape pauses and nothing moves (enemy x 19.3 frozen ticks 31-90); Title (down, Enter) returns to title. But Enter on Resume (menu_index 0) does nothing: still paused 40 ticks later, in four scripts with and without shoot held; only Escape resumes.
Shop opened after real wave 1: saved true, settings.json kept.save '1,50,5,10,0,0,normal'; next run title texts Start, Continue, Settings, Quit.
Run A: Continue -> shop coins 5, bought Quick (coins 0, quick 1). Run B: Continue -> shop wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1; Next wave -> 'Wave 2 of 8' with walkers entering.
Title from pause in wave 2: saved stays true, Continue on title; Start -> saved false and next run title has no Continue; lost run and won run both set saved false (kept.save empty).
Lost with 30 and best 0 -> best 30, lost screen 'Mejor: 30', later run title 'Mejor: 30'; lost with 30 and best 1500 keeps 'Record : 1 500'; won 1740 -> 'Mejor: 1740' on won screen and title.
Two identical settings copies, seed 7, same 900-tick script, 180 states: byte-identical output; seed 8 differs (other lanes); fresh Start seed 1 lanes 4,10,6,2,6 vs seed 2 lanes 10,10,6,10,8.

play.png (wave 8): gate tan bar at left, blue guard at y=5, green squares (walkers), orange balls (runners), big red block (brutes at y 8), yellow bolts at y=5 at the state's x; HUD 'Wave 8 of 8 Score: 120 Coins: 6 Gate: 94'.

Frames: English title (Start outlined), French title (Quitter outlined), Spanish settings (Idioma outlined), English shop (Heavy outlined) and Spanish shop (Albanil outlined), all in the chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, one per language; README 'Add a language' explains copying en.json and setting locale and name.

README gives controls, says kept things are in --settings FOLDER/settings.json (volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.save), and the play and frame commands, which ran as written (with my own folder).

defects: Pause menu: Enter on Resume does nothing; only Escape leaves the pause.
The gate is drawn red (low-health colour) behind the title and settings screens, because gate_health is 0 before any run.
Each Continue restarts the lane source, so every continued wave uses the same lane sequence (4,10,6,2,6,6,2,4,8,2... for seed 1).
A saved run is read without bounds: a save with gate 99 is accepted and the shop shows 'gate 99 of 14'.
After buying a shop item, the marked entry sometimes jumps (to Quick hands after Heavy was bought).
Spanish end screens say 'Enter: titulo' (the key's English name).
